name: kodflow-gamedev
description: Combat animation that is anatomically and martially right, for game projects that enable it. /move briefs a panel (director, anatomy, six martial areas, animation craft, rig, imagery, Godot and three.js) and turns its sourced proposals into measurable constraints; /anim-review measures a sampled clip against them and asks the owner's verdict; /anim-feedback records that verdict as an ADR that every later run reads first; /reference fetches licensed reference images; /meshy generates characters, weapons and props with Meshy, fetches them with their licence and judges them against the rig. Enabled per project, never installed by the user installer.
